first_page: Scores page /scores/ for sports fans who want today's results without ads or betting. First: "nba scores" opens every game of the day for a league (live score, clock, final), date arrows, tap a game for its box score, standings tab, favourite teams kept on the device that float to the top, a link that holds league+date. Built on a keyless public scoreboard feed cached at the edge. Will not build: fantasy, odds, video streaming, articles or alerts.
